type Double = number
interface O { name: string }
const XS: Double[] = [1.5, 2.5]
const OS: O[] = [{ name: 'a' }]
let calls = ''
function idx(k: number): number { calls = calls + 'i'; return k }
function dflt(): Double { calls = calls + 'd'; return 7.0 }
function closureAfterGuard(xs: Double[], i: number): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  if (v === undefined) return 'none'
  const f = (): string => String(v * 2.0)
  return f()
}
function loopGuard(xs: Double[], i: number): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  let out = ''
  for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
    if (v === undefined) continue
    out = out + String(v + k)
  }
  return out
}
function sw(xs: Double[], i: number, k: number): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  switch (k) {
    case 1:
      return String(v ?? 0.0)
    default:
      if (v === undefined) return 'none'
      return String(v * 2.0)
  }
}
function andNarrow(xs: Double[], i: number): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  return v !== undefined && v > 2.0 ? 'y' : 'n'
}
function elseNarrow(xs: Double[], i: number): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  if (v === undefined) {
    return 'none'
  } else {
    return String(v * 2.0)
  }
}
function multiExit(xs: Double[], i: number, flag: boolean): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  if (v === undefined) {
    if (flag) return 'a'
    else return 'b'
  }
  return String(v * 2.0)
}
function longExit(xs: Double[], i: number): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  let c = 0
  if (v === undefined) {
    c = c + 1
    c = c + 2
    return 'x' + String(c)
  }
  return String(v)
}
function ternRev(xs: Double[], i: number): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  return String(v !== undefined ? v * 2.0 : 0.0)
}
function aliasAfter(xs: Double[], i: number): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  if (v === undefined) return 'none'
  const w = v
  return String(w + 1.0)
}
function chainMix(os: O[], i: number): string {
  const v = os[i]
  return (v?.name ?? 'n') + (v === undefined ? '' : v.name)
}
function nestedFn(xs: Double[], i: number): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  const f = (): Double => {
    return v ?? 1.0
  }
  return String(f())
}
function foldSide(xs: Double[], k: number): string {
  calls = ''
  let v = xs[idx(k)]
  if (v === undefined) v = dflt()
  return String(v) + calls
}
function foldTernary(xs: Double[], i: number, c: boolean): string {
  let v = c ? xs[0] : xs[i]
  if (v === undefined) v = 1.0
  return String(v * 2.0)
}
function guardInIf(xs: Double[], i: number, flag: boolean): string {
  const v = xs[i]
  if (flag) {
    if (v === undefined) return 'a'
    return String(v + 1.0)
  }
  return 'f'
}
export function c_closure_after_guard_in(): string { return closureAfterGuard(XS, 1) }
export function c_loop_guard_in(): string { return loopGuard(XS, 0) }
export function c_loop_guard_out(): string { return loopGuard(XS, 5) }
export function c_switch_in(): string { return sw(XS, 1, 2) }
export function c_switch_out(): string { return sw(XS, 5, 2) }
export function c_switch_case1_out(): string { return sw(XS, 5, 1) }
export function c_and_in(): string { return andNarrow(XS, 1) }
export function c_else_in(): string { return elseNarrow(XS, 1) }
export function c_else_out(): string { return elseNarrow(XS, 9) }
export function c_multi_exit_out(): string { return multiExit(XS, 9, false) }
export function c_multi_exit_in(): string { return multiExit(XS, 0, true) }
export function c_long_exit_out(): string { return longExit(XS, 9) }
export function c_tern_rev_out(): string { return ternRev(XS, 9) }
export function c_alias_after_out(): string { return aliasAfter(XS, 9) }
export function c_alias_after_in(): string { return aliasAfter(XS, 0) }
export function c_chain_mix_out(): string { return chainMix(OS, 3) }
export function c_chain_mix_in(): string { return chainMix(OS, 0) }
export function c_nested_fn_out(): string { return nestedFn(XS, 4) }
export function c_fold_side_in(): string { return foldSide(XS, 1) }
export function c_fold_side_out(): string { return foldSide(XS, 8) }
export function c_fold_ternary_in(): string { return foldTernary(XS, 1, false) }
export function c_guard_in_if_out(): string { return guardInIf(XS, 9, true) }
